name: SPY NY Open VWAP Pullback
description: Intraday mean reversion strategy that trades opening range breakouts with pullbacks to NY Open VWAP (9:30am anchored). Enters long on bullish break + VWAP pullback, short on bearish break + VWAP rally. All positions closed at 3:45pm EST.
source:
# SPY NY Open VWAP Pullback Strategy
# Intraday mean reversion: Opening range breakout + VWAP pullback

# Data source - 5Min bars
src = market_data_source(timeframe=5Min)()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l
volume = src.v

# =============================================================================
# TIME EXTRACTION (EST timezone)
# =============================================================================
hour = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.hour, timezone="America/New_York")(index())
minute = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.minute, timezone="America/New_York")(index())

# Time conditions
after_opening_range = (hour > 9) or (hour == 9 and minute >= 45)
exit_time = hour == 15 and minute >= 45

# =============================================================================
# OPENING RANGE (9:30am - 9:45am EST)
# =============================================================================
opening_range = session_window(session=Session(start="09:30", end="09:45", tz="America/New_York"))()
or_high = opening_range.high
or_low = opening_range.low
or_closed = opening_range.closed

# Forward fill the opening range values after the window closes
or_high_ff = ffill(or_high)
or_low_ff = ffill(or_low)

# =============================================================================
# NY OPEN VWAP (Anchored at 9:30am session start)
# =============================================================================
# VWAP = cumulative(price * volume) / cumulative(volume)
typical_price = (high + low + close) / 3
pv = typical_price * volume

# Running sums that reset at session start (9:30am)
cum_pv = session_agg(session=EquityRTHSession, agg=AggregationType.Sum)(pv)
cum_vol = session_agg(session=EquityRTHSession, agg=AggregationType.Sum)(volume)

# VWAP calculation
vwap = cum_pv / cum_vol

# =============================================================================
# BIAS DETERMINATION (based on opening range breakout)
# =============================================================================
# Bullish bias: price breaks above opening range high
# Bearish bias: price breaks below opening range low

broke_above_or = close > or_high_ff
broke_below_or = close < or_low_ff

# Track if we've broken above or below (sticky bias for the day)
bullish_bias = hold_until()(enter=broke_above_or, exit=exit_time)
bearish_bias = hold_until()(enter=broke_below_or, exit=exit_time)

# =============================================================================
# PULLBACK TO VWAP DETECTION
# =============================================================================
# Price touching VWAP from above (for long entries)
# Previous bar above VWAP, current bar touches or crosses VWAP
prev_close = close >> 1
price_from_above = prev_close > vwap and low <= vwap

# Price touching VWAP from below (for short entries)
price_from_below = prev_close < vwap and high >= vwap

# =============================================================================
# ENTRY SIGNALS
# =============================================================================
# Long entry: bullish bias + pullback to VWAP from above + after opening range
long_entry = after_opening_range and bullish_bias and price_from_above and not exit_time

# Short entry: bearish bias + rally to VWAP from below + after opening range
short_entry = after_opening_range and bearish_bias and price_from_below and not exit_time

# =============================================================================
# EXECUTION
# =============================================================================
# Use long_and_short_zone with time-based exit
signal = long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=long_entry, short_entry=short_entry)

# Position sizing - fixed size
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=100)

# =============================================================================
# VISUALIZATION
# =============================================================================
timeseries_lines(
    title="Price vs VWAP",
    category="Indicators",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Close", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="VWAP", color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="OR High", color=Color.Green, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="OR Low", color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(close, vwap, or_high_ff, or_low_ff)

timeseries_lines(
    title="Trading Signal",
    category="Signals",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Signal (1=Long, -1=Short)", color=Color.Purple)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title="Flat", color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ])
)(signal)
